summary: First test run after MVP. Comprehensive backend (pytest, 8/8 passed) + frontend (Playwright e2e) verification of Jain Associates financial advisory site. All endpoints, lead persistence, validation, calculators, contact form integration, navigation, and toast notifications are working as expected. RESEND_API_KEY empty fallback is honored - leads still persist and email_sent=false (by design, NOT a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is small (~187 lines) and clean. Email send uses asyncio.to_thread which is correct for Resend SDK sync client.
GET /api/leads correctly excludes _id via projection {_id:0} - good.
created_at stored as ISO string and re-parsed on read - works, but storing as native BSON datetime would be cleaner and avoid the try/except fallback.
Pydantic v2 EmailStr validation works (verified 422 on invalid email/missing fields/short name).
CORS is fully open (*) which is acceptable for MVP but should be tightened to the production frontend domain before launch.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads - consider adding a simple IP/email throttle to prevent spam since the form is public.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly (no hardcoded URLs found in LeadForm).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed leads (TEST_Sambhav, TEST_Sort0/1, TEST UI Sambhav, TEST Toast) via API + UI during testing. Recommend periodic cleanup of TEST_ leads from the leads collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_jain_api.py is reusable for regression. When the user provides RESEND_API_KEY, update test_health_status assertion (email_configured may be True) and verify email_sent=true on a real lead. All data-testid hooks are in place: site-navbar, nav-link-{home/vision/team/calculators/contact}, hero-section, hero-cta-primary/secondary, stats-showcase, calc-tab-{sip/lumpsum/goal/retirement/emi/term}, calc-content-*, lead-form, lead-form-name/email/phone/service/message/submit, lead-form-success, contact-map-frame.
verified_flows: POST /api/leads (valid) -> 200 success=true, lead_id uuid, email_sent=false (by design)
GET /api/leads -> list, no _id leakage, sorted desc by created_at, persisted lead matches input
Home / -> hero 'Building Generational Wealth with Integrity & Expertise.' + stats (100, 1400, Top 50, 45) visible
/calculators -> all 6 tabs render and switching shows correct content
/contact -> form submit hits POST /api/leads (200), success card 'Thank you' shown, map iframe visible
Sonner toast region present and shows 'Thanks! We'll reach out within 1 business day.' on submit
No JS console errors / page errors during full e2e run
